conditions.instrument: zeta potential and particle size analyzer (Malvern Panalytical)

measurements.evidence_quote: The values of both PS-MPs (Figure 1G) and SeNPs (Figure 1H) are quite high. || The mixture of PS-MPs and sterile water and the mixture of SeNPs and sterile water were diluted to 50 mg/L and sonicated, followed by transfer to a zeta flow cell and a quartz cuvette cell (Malvern Panalytical, Malvern, UK) for characterization. || The liquid-phase surface charge of PS-MPs and SeNPs was measured using zeta potential and a particle size analyzer (Malvern Panalytical, Malvern, UK).
